title: A little disappointed
text: A little disappointed. I was so excited for this bundt cake pan but then u used it. It doesn't cook evenly. The cake came out if it easy but it was raw in the middle and just wouldn't cook. I figure I can use it as a jello mold because it didn't work for baking.
